q: A person who belongs legally to a country and enjoys full rights is a ____. (P3)
explain: Citizenship grants constitutional rights, privileges, and responsibilities.
hint: A recognized legal member of a state.

q: Standing at attention when the national anthem is sung shows ____. (P3)
explain: Honoring national symbols shows civic love and loyalty to one's nation.

q: Traffic lights: What does the RED light instruct drivers to do? (P3)
explain: Red signal means stop completely behind the line.
hint: Signal to bring vehicle to a halt.

q: Traffic lights: What does the AMBER / YELLOW light indicate? (P3)
explain: Amber prepares drivers to stop safely or prepare to go.
hint: Caution signal before red or green.

q: Traffic lights: What does the GREEN light instruct drivers to do? (P3)
explain: Green gives legal right-of-way to proceed safely.

q: Civic duty (P3): Paying taxes promptly to the government is a civic ____.
explain: duty / obligation is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): Protecting public utilities like streetlights and water pipes is the responsibility of ____.
explain: all citizens is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): A citizen should always obey lawful orders from the ____.
explain: police and courts is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): Treating people of different ethnic groups and religions with kindness is called ____.
explain: tolerance and unity is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): Which of these is a civic responsibility of a student in school?
explain: Keeping the school compound clean is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): A child's right to life, healthcare, and education is protected by the ____ Act.
explain: Child Rights is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): When singing the National Anthem, citizens should ____.
explain: stand upright and pay attention is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): The Independent Corrupt Practices Commission is abbreviated as ____.
explain: ICPC is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): Refusing to join secret cults and violence in school demonstrates moral ____.
explain: courage and discipline is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P3): The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) was established in 1973 to promote national ____.
explain: unity and integration is the essential civic principle.
